name: anthropic_message
description: Send a message to Claude and get a response. Full control over model, system prompt, temperature, tools, and tool_choice.

name: anthropic_message_with_tools
description: Send a message with client tool definitions. Returns real pending tool calls for the calling agent to execute; continue with anthropic_message and actual tool results. Does not run client tools automatically.

max_turns.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter. One provider response is returned; the calling agent executes client tools.

name: anthropic_count_tokens
description: Count the number of tokens in a prompt before sending it to Claude

name: anthropic_list_models
description: List all available Claude models

name: anthropic_get_model
description: Get details about a specific Claude model

name: anthropic_create_batch
description: Create a batch of Claude API requests to process asynchronously at reduced cost

name: anthropic_get_batch
description: Get the status and results of a batch request

name: anthropic_list_batches
description: List all batch jobs in the Anthropic account

name: anthropic_cancel_batch
description: Cancel a running batch job

name: anthropic_get_batch_results
description: Download the results of a completed batch job as a list of responses

name: anthropic_list_files
description: List all files uploaded to the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_get_file
description: Get metadata about a specific file uploaded to the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the Anthropic API

name: anthropic_get_usage
description: Get API usage and cost statistics for the Anthropic account

name: anthropic_quick_ask
description: Quick single question to Claude Haiku for fast, cheap responses. Great for classification, extraction, and simple tasks.

name: anthropic_message_from_url
description: Fetch a URL and ask Claude a question about its contents. Returns the response plus the source size. Useful for analyzing articles, blog posts, or simple HTML pages.

name: anthropic_score_text
description: Score text against multiple criteria with a score and reason for each. Returns a JSON object mapping each criterion to {score, reason}. Useful for evaluations and rubrics.

name: anthropic_redact_pii
description: Redact personally identifiable information (names, emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards, addresses, DOBs) from text. Returns the redacted text. Uses Haiku by default for speed.

name: anthropic_vision_message
description: Send images (by URL or base64) to Claude with a question. Returns the text response. Use for OCR, screenshot analysis, image description.

name: anthropic_pdf_message
description: Analyze a PDF document with Claude. Accepts either pdf_base64 or file_id (from anthropic_upload_file). Uses files-api + pdfs beta headers.

name: anthropic_message_with_caching
description: Send a message with explicit prompt caching on a large context block. Returns cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens for cost analysis.

name: anthropic_message_with_thinking
description: Send a message with extended thinking enabled. Returns the thinking trace separately from the response. Best with Opus models.

name: anthropic_message_stream
description: Send a message with streaming and accumulate the full response. Returns the complete text after the stream finishes plus token usage.

name: anthropic_extract_json
description: Extract structured JSON from unstructured text using a JSON Schema. Returns {parsed, raw, usage}. Use for parsing emails, documents, transcripts.

name: anthropic_classify
description: Classify text into one of a provided list of labels using Claude Haiku. Returns the chosen label.

name: anthropic_summarize
description: Summarize text into a specified number of sentences with Claude Haiku. Fast and cheap.

name: anthropic_translate
description: Translate text between languages with Claude. Auto-detects source if not specified.

name: anthropic_extract_entities
description: Extract named entities (people, organizations, locations, dates, emails, phones, URLs by default — or custom types) from text as structured JSON.

name: anthropic_upload_file
description: Upload a file (provided as base64) to the Anthropic Files API for use with PDF analysis or multimodal messages. Uses files-api beta.

name: anthropic_get_file_content
description: Download the content of a file previously uploaded to the Anthropic Files API, returned as base64.

name: anthropic_upload_file_from_url
description: Fetch a file from a URL and upload it to the Anthropic Files API in one step. Useful for processing remote documents.

name: anthropic_batch_simple
description: Create a Claude message batch from a simple array of prompts. Each prompt becomes a separate request with the same model and system prompt. Returns the batch object.

name: anthropic_wait_for_batch
description: Poll a batch until processing_status === 'ended' or timeout. Returns the final batch object.

name: anthropic_delete_batch
description: Delete a message batch and its results (only allowed once batch has ended).

name: anthropic_list_workspaces

description: List members of a workspace and their roles. Requires Admin API key.

description: Get a workspace member's role. Requires Admin API key.

description: Add a user to a workspace with a role (workspace_admin, workspace_developer, workspace_billing, workspace_user). Requires Admin API key.

description: Change a workspace member's role. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_remove_workspace_member
description: Remove a user from a workspace. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_list_org_users
description: List all users in the Anthropic organization. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_get_org_user
description: Get details for a specific organization user. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_update_org_user
description: Update a user's organization role (admin, billing, developer, user). Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_remove_org_user
description: Remove a user from the Anthropic organization. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_list_org_invites
description: List pending invites to your Anthropic organization. Requires Admin API key.

description: Send an invite to join your Anthropic organization. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_delete_org_invite
description: Cancel a pending organization invite. Requires Admin API key.

description: List API keys in your organization, optionally filtered by workspace. Requires Admin API key.

description: Get details for an API key (metadata only — key value is not returned). Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_update_api_key
description: Rename an API key or change its status (active/inactive). Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_get_usage_report
description: Get message usage statistics with grouping and time bucketing. Useful for tracking token consumption per workspace/model. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_get_cost_report
description: Get USD cost breakdown over a time range with optional grouping by workspace/model. Requires Admin API key.

name: anthropic_summarize_long_doc
description: SUPER TOOL: Summarize a long document by chunking + per-chunk Haiku summaries + final merge with the chosen model. Handles arbitrarily long inputs.

name: anthropic_compare_models
description: SUPER TOOL: Send the same prompt to multiple Claude models in parallel and return side-by-side responses with latency and usage. Defaults to Opus + Sonnet + Haiku.

name: anthropic_batch_classify
description: SUPER TOOL: Classify a list of items using the Batch API with one shared label set. Returns the batch_id for polling. 50% cheaper than realtime.

name: anthropic_extract_structured
description: SUPER TOOL: Extract a JSON object matching a schema, with automatic retry on parse failure (max_retries=1 by default). Returns the parsed object on success.

name: anthropic_chat_session
description: SUPER TOOL: Stateful chat — pass the returned history array back as input on the next call to continue the conversation. Returns {response, history, usage}.

name: anthropic_invite_workspace_member
description: Invite a user to an Anthropic workspace by email with a specified role. Requires ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY. Roles: developer, billing, admin.

name: anthropic_create_api_key
description: Create a new API key for the Anthropic organization. Requires ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY. The key value is only returned once at creation time.

name: anthropic_disable_api_key
description: Disable an Anthropic API key by key ID. Requires ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY. Immediately revokes the key without deleting the record.

name: gemini_standard_query
description: Send a prompt to Google Gemini and get a text response. Supports system_instruction, temperature, max_tokens, and model override. Default model: gemini-2.5-flash.

name: gemini_structured_extractor
description: Extract JSON from a prompt using a JSON Schema. Returns {json, raw, usage}. Uses Gemini's native responseSchema mode for guaranteed schema-conformant output.

name: gemini_code_execution_engine
description: Ask Gemini to solve a problem by writing and executing Python in a sandboxed environment. Returns the answer plus executable_code and execution_result blocks. Great for math, data analysis, and verification tasks.

name: gemini_grounded_query
description: Query Gemini with Google Search grounding enabled. Returns the answer plus grounding_metadata and citations from real web sources. Use when factual freshness matters.

name: gemini_analyze_media
description: Upload a media file (image, audio, video, or PDF) via base64 or file_path and ask Gemini a question about it. Uses the Files API and supports the full 1M-token multimodal context.

name: gemini_generate_image
description: Generate one or more images from a text prompt using Imagen (default: imagen-3.0-generate-002). Saves each image to output_path and returns the saved file paths.

name: gemini_spatial_analysis
description: Detect objects in an image and return JSON bounding boxes normalized to a 0-1000 grid: [{label, box_2d:[ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax]}]. Supply file_base64 or file_path plus an optional target_objects hint.

name: gemini_text_to_speech
description: Synthesize speech from text using Gemini native TTS (default model: gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts). Writes the audio to output_path. Voice defaults to 'Kore'.

name: gemini_generate_embeddings
description: Generate text embeddings using text-embedding-004 (or any embedding model). Accepts a single string or an array (uses batchEmbedContents for arrays). Returns the vector(s) plus dimensions.

name: gemini_cache_document
description: Create a Gemini context cache for a large document or system instruction. Returns cache_name to reuse across subsequent generateContent calls for major cost savings. Requires a billing-enabled GCP project.

name: gemini_batch_processor
description: Process an array of prompts in parallel with bounded concurrency (default 4). Returns per-prompt {ok, text, usage|error}. Client-side fan-out — works on any tier.

name: gemini_deep_research_start
description: Submit a server-side batchGenerateContent long-running operation for large-scale or background work. Returns operation_name to poll with gemini_deep_research_status.

name: gemini_deep_research_status
description: Poll the status of a long-running Gemini operation by operation_name. Returns {done, metadata, response, error}.

name: gemini_cancel_batch_job
description: Cancel a running Gemini long-running operation. Falls back to DELETE if :cancel is rejected. Returns the final operation state.

name: gemini_list_models
description: Enumerate available Gemini models with display_name, version, input/output token limits, and supported generation methods. Useful for model discovery before using other gemini_* tools.

name: gemini_chat
description: Send a multi-turn conversation history to Gemini and get the next assistant reply. Pass messages as [{role, text}] array; returns updated_messages array ready for the next turn. Supports system instructions, temperature, and max_tokens.

name: gemini_function_call
description: Call Gemini with tool/function definitions and get back either a text response or a structured function call request. Supports tool_choice mode (AUTO, ANY, NONE) to control when Gemini uses tools.

tools.description: Function declarations: [{name, description, parameters: {type, properties, required}}]

tool_choice.description: AUTO=Gemini decides, ANY=force tool use, NONE=text only

name: gemini_count_tokens
description: Count tokens for a prompt or conversation before sending to Gemini, to verify it fits within the model context window. Returns total_tokens count so you can compare against the model limit before making an expensive request.

contents.description: Raw contents array for multi-turn token counting

name: gemini_analyze_image_url
description: Analyze an image at a public URL using Gemini vision — no file upload needed. Fetches the image bytes directly and passes them inline to Gemini. Faster than gemini_analyze_media for small public images.

name: gemini_edit_image
description: Edit an existing image using Imagen's inpainting and editing capabilities. Provide the source image (file_path or file_base64), an optional mask for targeted edits, and a text prompt describing the change. Returns the edited image saved to output_path.

prompt.description: Description of the edit to make

mask_base64.description: Optional base64 mask — white=edit area, black=keep

name: gemini_list_files
description: List files previously uploaded to the Gemini Files API. Returns file names, URIs, MIME types, sizes, processing states, and expiration times. Files expire after 48 hours unless refreshed.

name: gemini_get_file
description: Get metadata and status for a specific file uploaded to the Gemini Files API by its file name (e.g. 'files/abc123'). Check the state field — ACTIVE means ready to use; PROCESSING means still uploading.

name: gemini_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the Gemini Files API by its file name. Frees up quota. Files are automatically deleted after 48 hours, but use this for immediate cleanup or to remove sensitive content.

name: gemini_list_cached_contents
description: List all cached content entries created with gemini_cache_document. Returns cache names, associated models, creation times, and expiration times. Use to audit active caches and their TTLs.

name: gemini_delete_cached_content
description: Delete a specific cached content entry from the Gemini context cache by its cache name. Use after processing is done or to free up quota. Cache names come from gemini_cache_document or gemini_list_cached_contents.

name: gemini_query_with_cache
description: Query Gemini using a previously cached document context as a prefix. Dramatically reduces token costs when repeatedly querying against the same large document or codebase. cache_name comes from gemini_cache_document.

name: gemini_thinking_query
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a complex multi-step reasoning task to Gemini 2.5 Pro with extended thinking enabled. The model reasons through the problem step-by-step before answering. Returns both the thinking process and the final answer. Best for math, logic, code review, and research synthesis.

thinking_budget.description: Max thinking tokens (0=disable, -1=dynamic/unlimited, or a specific number)

name: gemini_transcribe_video
description: Transcribe or analyze a video file using Gemini's multimodal vision capabilities. Uploads the video to the Files API, waits for processing, then generates a timestamped transcript or answers a custom prompt about the video content.

name: gemini_multi_speaker_tts
description: Generate multi-speaker audio with different voices for each speaker using Gemini's native TTS. Pass an array of {speaker, text, voice} turns and get back a single audio file with natural voice switching between speakers. Ideal for dialogue, podcasts, or narration.

turns.description: Array of {speaker: string, text: string, voice?: string} — voice defaults to Kore/Charon/Fenrir/Aoede in rotation

name: gemini_document_ocr
description: Extract text from a scanned document, image, or PDF using Gemini vision. Supports three output formats: plain text (default), Markdown (preserves structure and headings), or JSON (structured sections). Automatically uses the Files API for documents larger than 20MB.

name: gemini_compare_documents
description: Upload two documents to Gemini and compare them side-by-side — identifying differences, similarities, and key changes. Useful for contract redlining, policy diff analysis, or comparing report versions. Supports PDF, images, and any Gemini-supported format.

file_content.description: File content as text or base64

name: moonshot_long_context_summarize
description: SUPER TOOL: Summarize a very large document (up to 128K tokens) using moonshot-v1-128k. Returns structured or plain summary with usage stats. Ideal for contracts, reports, and research papers.

text.description: Full document text to summarize (up to ~512K characters)

format.description: Output format: structured (default, with sections) or plain

name: moonshot_compare_documents

comparison_focus.description: What aspect to focus comparison on (default: key differences and similarities)

data.description: Row data to insert or update

update_columns.description: Columns to update on conflict (defaults to all non-conflict columns)

name: neon_get_sample_rows
description: Get a random sample of rows from a table using TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM for fast random access.

name: neon_export_table_csv
description: Export table rows as CSV-formatted text with optional WHERE filter and row limit.

name: neon_copy_table_data
description: Copy rows from one table into another using INSERT ... SELECT. Skips conflicts.

name: neon_enable_pgvector
description: Enable the pgvector extension in the database for AI embedding and similarity search support.

name: neon_create_vector_table
description: Create a table with a vector embedding column, metadata jsonb, and timestamps — ready for pgvector similarity search.

dimensions.description: Embedding dimensions: 1536 for OpenAI, 768 for others (default 1536)

name: neon_create_vector_index
description: Create an HNSW or IVFFlat index on a vector column for fast approximate nearest-neighbor search.

name: neon_insert_embedding
description: Insert a single vector embedding with its content and metadata into a pgvector table.

embedding.description: Float array of the embedding vector

name: neon_bulk_insert_embeddings
description: Insert multiple vector embeddings in a single batch INSERT for efficient RAG data loading.

name: neon_similarity_search_cosine
description: Find the most similar vectors using cosine similarity (1 - cosine distance). Returns content, similarity score, and metadata.

query_embedding.description: The query vector to search against

name: neon_similarity_search_l2
description: Find the most similar vectors using L2 (Euclidean) distance — lower distance means more similar.

name: neon_list_vector_tables
description: Find all tables in the database that have a vector column (pgvector enabled tables).

name: neon_enable_full_text_search
description: Enable pg_trgm and unaccent extensions for full-text and trigram fuzzy search support.

name: neon_create_fts_index
description: Create a GIN index on one or more text columns to enable fast full-text search with tsvector.

columns.description: Text columns to include in the FTS index

name: neon_full_text_search
description: Search text columns using PostgreSQL full-text search with ranked results. Uses plainto_tsquery.

name: neon_trigram_search
description: Fuzzy search using pg_trgm trigram similarity — tolerates typos and partial matches.

name: neon_list_all_db_roles
description: List all PostgreSQL database roles with their attributes (superuser, login, replication, etc.).

name: neon_list_role_privileges
description: Show all table privileges granted to a specific database role in a schema.

name: neon_grant_table_access
description: GRANT specific privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on a table to a role.

name: neon_revoke_table_access
description: REVOKE privileges on a table from a role.

name: neon_grant_schema_access
description: GRANT USAGE on a schema to a role, optionally also granting SELECT on all tables within it.

also_grant_tables.description: Also GRANT SELECT on all tables (default false)

name: neon_create_readonly_role
description: Create a read-only database role with SELECT access to one or more schemas, including future tables.

name: neon_get_rls_policies
description: List all Row Level Security policies on a table or schema.

name: neon_create_rls_policy
description: Create a Row Level Security policy on a table controlling which rows a role can see or modify.

name: neon_drop_rls_policy
description: Drop a Row Level Security policy from a table.

name: neon_enable_rls
description: Enable Row Level Security on a table. Use FORCE to apply to table owner as well.

force.description: Apply RLS to table owner too

name: neon_disable_rls
description: Disable Row Level Security on a table.

name: neon_get_database_stats
description: Get comprehensive database statistics from pg_stat_database including connections, commits, cache hits, and temp files.

name: neon_get_table_io_stats
description: Show heap and index I/O statistics per table — reveals cache hit ratios at the table level.

name: neon_get_vacuum_stats
description: Show vacuum and analyze history for all tables with dead tuple counts. Identifies tables needing maintenance.

name: neon_get_transaction_id_age
description: Check XID (transaction ID) age for all databases — critical for detecting wraparound risk before it causes a database shutdown.

name: neon_check_unused_indexes
description: Find indexes that have never been used (zero scans since last stats reset) — candidates for removal to save space.

name: neon_get_temp_file_usage
description: Show temp file generation stats — high numbers indicate work_mem is too low and queries are spilling to disk.

name: neon_get_wait_events
description: Show what backends and queries are currently waiting on (locks, I/O, network, etc.).

name: neon_get_index_health
description: Comprehensive index health report showing size, scan count, and health status (UNUSED, LOW, OK) for all non-primary indexes.

name: neon_get_account_consumption

name: neon_list_projects_by_consumption

name: neon_test_connection

name: neon_list_endpoints

name: neon_delete_endpoint

name: neon_update_endpoint

name: neon_get_connection_stats

name: neon_delete_webhook

name: neon_get_performance_insights

num_predict.description: Max tokens to generate (-1 for unlimited)

instruction.description: What to do with the code, or a description of code to generate

schema_hint.description: Describe the expected JSON structure to guide the model

role.description: Agent role e.g. 'a senior TypeScript developer' or 'a database architect'

context.description: Relevant context, code, or data the agent needs

output_format.description: Describe the desired output format e.g. 'a JSON array' or 'a numbered list'

name: voyage_embed
description: Generate embeddings using Voyage AI. Supports voyage-3 (default), voyage-3-lite, voyage-code-3, voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2, and voyage-multilingual-2 models.

texts.description: Array of text strings to embed

input_type.description: Input type hint: query or document (improves quality)

name: voyage_embed_query
description: Embed a single search query using Voyage AI with query-optimized settings for maximum retrieval relevance. Returns a single embedding vector.

query.description: Search query text to embed

name: voyage_embed_documents
description: Batch embed a list of documents using Voyage AI with document-optimized settings. Best for indexing content into a vector database.

documents.description: Array of document strings to embed

name: voyage_embed_code
description: Embed code snippets using voyage-code-3, Voyage AI's state-of-the-art code embedding model. Best performance for code search and retrieval tasks.

texts.description: Array of code snippets or technical text to embed

name: voyage_embed_finance
description: Embed financial documents using voyage-finance-2. Optimized for financial filings, earnings reports, and economic text. Superior retrieval for finance use cases.

name: voyage_embed_legal
description: Embed legal text using voyage-law-2. Optimized for contracts, case law, statutes, and legal documents. Best-in-class for legal RAG applications.

name: voyage_embed_multilingual
description: Embed text in multiple languages using voyage-multilingual-2. Supports cross-lingual retrieval across 10+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and more.

name: voyage_rerank
description: Rerank a list of candidate documents by relevance to a query using Voyage's cross-encoder reranker. Significantly improves retrieval precision as a post-processing step after vector search.

query.description: Search query to rank documents against

documents.description: Array of document strings to rerank

top_k.description: Return only the top K results (default: all)

return_documents.description: Include document text in results (default: true)

name: voyage_list_models
description: List all available Voyage AI embedding and reranking models with their context lengths, dimensions, and intended use cases.

name: voyage_compare_similarity
description: SUPER TOOL: Embed two texts and return their cosine similarity score (0-1) with a human-readable interpretation. Useful for semantic similarity checks and deduplication.

name: voyage_search_pipeline
description: SUPER TOOL: Full RAG retrieval pipeline — embed query with Voyage + score candidates by cosine similarity + rerank top results in one call. Returns relevance-ranked documents ready to pass to an LLM.

query.description: Search query

candidate_documents.description: Array of candidate document strings to search through

top_k.description: Number of top results to return (default: 5)
